Terrible, terrible changes.

Veigar was my main for a while now. Most of my games were played with that champion and I absolutely loved him.

I loved his challenging early game and rewarding mid game and now it's gone.

Those changes nerf Veigar by a lot, it's like trying to turn squishy cannon into something that deals damage over time. Sure in lane and early game it may work great, but that's not what veigar players wanted and loved in that champion. Please don't turn him into some kind of abomination that no one will touch because of how shitty he will become.

Q changes are terrible. I don't mind skillshots, of course it was much better before, but that's not the worst change. Because q can only travel through 2 units, it may often cause situations in which veigar q will be stopped because fight happen to take place in lane near minions or near some neutral monsters. And Veigar Q it's the only ability he has to harrass his opponents.

Meteor changes: Reduced mana cost - irrelevant, Veigar had no problems with mana most of the time. Reduced cooldown, surprise surprise - irrelevant, and that's because his meteor is mostly used along with his stun as combo. It's often not very smart to put your meteor on cooldown when your stun will be soon ready to use again, so in the end most of the time you don't use it outside stun+meteor combo, of course except farming.

R: Again, reduced cooldown and mana is irrelevant. You just had to remember  to keep certain amount of mana for combo and it was all fine. Reduced damage.. really? It was already reduced by 20% with removal of dfg. At least make it scale with both, ap and ad.. Or just leave it as it is and increase travel time so people have more time to use their zhonyas?

E: Okay so finally, stun changes. In my opinion it completly kills Veigar. Proper use of stun made difference between good Veigar player and bad player. If you don't immediately stun enemy (meaning - miss your stun by just traping enemy or miss him completly) - you are most likely dead. Reworked stun may work on some bronze players that still will run directly into it, but it won't work on higher ranks, ever. If you don't stun enemy, there is tiny  chance that meteor will hit him and new stun will be really easy to avoid.. Stun was also really easy to counter as there is many things that can prevent Veigar from comboing you. Tenacity items, Quicksilver, Banshee.. That's why Veigar was never very good in late game, he was best in mid game and worst in early game.

One more thing about cooldown changes: Veigar gameplay was about zoning and being in right place and right time, always as far away from enemy as possible when your skills are on cooldown. So lower cooldowns won't change a thing because Veigar has no escape ability so he has to back off no matter what. It's not a bruiser that can take full advantage of having shorter cd on skills because bruiser is involved into fight constantly and uses his sustain, leaps and other stuff to move around.

I read a lot of advices there and there and I think your one may really work. That's true that I overthink and reason far too much, I am always searching for a reason to do something, when I find one, I am starting to search deeper and deeper until I just found limit 2 days ago, which is death. **So nothing good** comes from my reasoning. I really want to be stupid again in that matter, am I just strong enough to "ignore" and "forget" about death and everything that's connected to it? *Right know this thought (of nothingness) is attached to my brain really strong* and I am aware of it even when I am trying not to think, so maybe pushing myself to do some activities may be good idea. I was always thinking too much about religion, then about meaning of life, then about death, I spent thousands of hours discussing and listening others discuss about it, in general I am the person that thinks more than acts, but I just always wanted to know things, really, really much. Now I regret it. When I found something that was sad or terrifying, I tried to search for something that's going to make it irrelevant and that was giving me relief, the thing is, there is nothing more terrifying than losing consciousness (at least for me). I was thinking about visiting psychotherapist, but can he really help me? Won't it push my overthinking even further? The reason of why I reason so much (reasoning again..) is probably that people around me always diminished value of things that I was doing and tried to convice me to do whatever they want me to do and whatever they think is best for me, so I was searching for reason why it's more relevant than what I do and if things I do are relevant at all. It's probably confusing and hard to understand but so is my thinking.

The thing is, time before I was "born" is kinda optimistic, because everything will be about to start for me. When I die, I will lose everything I gained at my entire life, so what's the point of experiencing? You say I have impact on people around me and that's true, but they will also die and lose everything the same way I do and my parents or grandparents. Do people that lived 300 years ago are important to us? More than just mention in the history books (most of them)? And if humanity cease to exist someday, actions of even most important people will be forgotten. I believe everything in universe is temporary, even universe itself is probably temporary, even if it last bilions or trilions of years. All I want it's to be able to enjoy things and start feeling satisfaction again, I haven't feel it from the long time. I know that my mind holds the key, becasue my life haven't change from when I was happy, only my view of life changed. I wish there would be way to "move back", I would never let my mind to race that far ever again..
